title: fix: add role-based access control to admin endpoints
head: xiaofengzii:fix/admin-rbac-5758
body:
## Summary
This PR adds role-based access control (RBAC) to admin endpoints.

## Changes
- Add `requireAdmin` middleware in `apps/api/src/middleware/auth.js` that checks `req.user.role === 'admin'`
- Apply `requireAdmin` middleware to admin routes alongside existing `authMiddleware`
- Return 403 with descriptive error for non-admin authenticated users
- Add tests for admin access, missing token, and non-admin roles

## Testing
- All tests pass: `node --test src/tests/admin.test.js`

/claim #743
Closes #5758
